parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Query page number, used for pagination.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Query page size, used for pagination.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description:
WAF rule type. Values:

- http_anti_scan: Scan protection
- http_bot: Bots

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-waf-rules --site-id 1 --site-version 0 --phase http_custom --ruleset-id 10000001 --query-args http_custom --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa ListWafRules --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --RulesetId 10000001 --Phase http_custom --QueryArgs http_custom --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --SiteVersion 0
